panel.title: Annotations
panel.addTooltip: Add annotation, or right-click the flight trace on any map
panel.requestReviewTooltip: Ask a pilot to review this flight
panel.publicOn: Your annotations are visible on community and shared views
panel.publicOff: Show your annotations on community and shared views
panel.emptyHint: Right-click a point of the flight trace on the map to add one.
panel.blockDescription: They will no longer be able to annotate any of your flights. Their existing annotations stay until you delete them. You can unblock them anytime from your profile page.

dialog.title: Annotate this flight
dialog.description: Pin a remark to a moment of the flight. Plain text only: links and markup are not allowed.
dialog.placeholder: e.g. You left this thermal too early. The climb was still 2 m/s.

validation.markup: Annotation cannot contain the characters < or >

reviewer.title: Request a review
reviewer.description: Ask a more experienced pilot to review this flight and leave annotations on the track. Enter the exact email address they use on We-Fly. For privacy, pilots cannot be browsed or searched.
reviewer.hint: The pilot will receive an email and a notification asking them to review this flight.
reviewer.found: This email matches a pilot on We-Fly.
reviewer.notFound: No pilot with this email accepts review requests.

toasts.blocked: Pilot blocked from annotating your flights
toasts.visibilityOn: Your annotations are now visible on community and shared views

errors.timeCodeOutOfRange: Flight time code is out of range
errors.notAllowed: You are not allowed to annotate this flight
